_comment: Every skill on the toc-extraction/bo leaderboard, keyed by the `variant` in its result.json. status: promoted (ships in buddhist-skills), challenger, baseline, or reference (useful to compare against but cannot ship as this task's skill). Edit this file by hand; LEADERBOARD.md and the site are generated from it and the result.json files. Optional per skill: `name` (display name; the variant id stays in result.json and skill refs) and `hidden: true` (kept in the repo but left off every leaderboard). `skill_md` links to the SKILL.md that was tested.

splits.same-book: 76 passages of A Lamp Illuminating the Intent of Vasubandhu. The GEPA-optimized skill was tuned on 48 other passages of this book.
splits.held-out-book: 9 passages of The Jewel Garland, a book no skill was tuned on. Its references are known to miss real headings, so precision is understated for every skill.

notes: TOC extraction (sa-bcad method) and TOC extraction (GEPA-optimized) are a near-tie: the gap in the mean of both models is within run-to-run noise, and the GEPA-optimized skill does better on the held-out book. Re-run both after the held-out references are fixed (benchmark toc-extraction/bo 1.0.1).

sabcad-outliner and sabcad-outliner+script are a .docx outliner skill run through a benchmark adapter. They can't ship as a TOC skill as they are; TOC extraction (sa-bcad method) is the shippable form.

sabcad-outliner-toc.approach: A colleague's hand-written sa-bcad method (rules for ordinals, ལ་N announcements and ནི introducers, plus a code scheme), with a short TOC task section and the GEPA-optimized skill's output rules on top. 21k characters of instructions.
sabcad-outliner-toc.name: TOC extraction (sa-bcad method)

gepa-v1.approach: A short hand-written prompt rewritten by DSPy GEPA, an automatic prompt optimiser, on 48 passages of one book (task model Haiku 4.5, reflection model Sonnet 4.5). 11k characters. Some rules quote its training passages.
gepa-v1.name: TOC extraction (GEPA-optimized)

seed.approach: A one-paragraph hand-written prompt (0.6k characters), the starting point for GEPA. Any skill should beat it.

sabcad-outliner.approach: The colleague's original skill, written to produce a .docx outline, run through a benchmark adapter that asks for the heading list instead.
sabcad-outliner.made_by: A colleague of WeBuddhist (Tsong Khapa Outliner project)

sabcad-outliner+script.approach: The same as sabcad-outliner, plus the output of its extract_sabcad.py script as a list of candidate headings. Helps Sonnet, hurts Haiku.
sabcad-outliner+script.made_by: A colleague of WeBuddhist (Tsong Khapa Outliner project)
